plugins.name: codetogo
plugins.description: CodeToGo companion commands + skills: the codetogo:docs skill (answer how-to questions from codetogo.app/docs), the codetogo:cli skill (find/read sessions, map PTY ↔ agent ids, triage what's waiting), /codetogo:spawn (start titled sessions now, one per task), /codetogo:schedule (fire a pre-seeded session later), plus /codetogo:handoff, /codetogo:resume, /codetogo:copy, and /codetogo:compact (in-place context reset for a live session)
